comment: [PC][2016-2019] Puzzle game with a sad backstory I remember I watched the entire gameplay on youtube. It was a puzzle game where you had to save people from getting killed and it took place during a masquerade ball. You had to move foward and backward in time, saving everyone one by one. I don't remember the character's names but the finale has a big twist: the protagonist is stuck in a loop of dread, his wife and daughter/son are dead and he's living with the remorse of doing nothing (something, probably a fire, killed them). The graphics were 3D and was really weird, in a charming way, (that stuck with me for some time).

[Unknown] [Unknown] Game about truck driving POV was from inside the truck and you could see your surroundings outside the truck, similar to real driving. The goal of the game was to pick up and drop off loads. You would travel on interstates and highways to locations like Indianapolis. There were road signs that looked very similar to real life. There were gas stations and rest stops at exits. Everything looked really realistic. Played this game a lot on the computer around 2009 and 2010. Think I came across the game several years later, but I forget the name.
